classification.difficultyReason: Introduce an auxiliary horizontal length and connect two tangent equations through the known difference, then eliminate that length and collect the shared unknown height without procedural cues.

content.prompt: Find the value of $x$, correct to 1 decimal place, in these triangles.

spec.description: Two right triangles share vertical side x. The interior segment meets the top side at the 50° angle. Dimension 10 applies only from this meeting point to the rightmost vertex.
spec.mathematics: The outer rightmost angle is 25°. The smaller triangle's top-right angle is 50°. Both triangles have their right angle at the top-left vertex.

answer.worked:
Let $s$ be the smaller triangle's horizontal side. The full horizontal side is $s+10$.
$$\begin{align*}\tan50^\circ&=\frac{x}{s}\\s\tan50^\circ&=x\\s&=\frac{x}{\tan50^\circ}\\\tan25^\circ&=\frac{x}{s+10}\\(s+10)\tan25^\circ&=x\\s+10&=\frac{x}{\tan25^\circ}\\\frac{x}{\tan50^\circ}+10&=\frac{x}{\tan25^\circ}\\10&=x\left(\frac{1}{\tan25^\circ}-\frac{1}{\tan50^\circ}\right)\\x&=\frac{10}{\frac{1}{\tan25^\circ}-\frac{1}{\tan50^\circ}}\\x&\approx7.7\end{align*}$$
